01-01-desktop: Bliss desktop, taskbar, desktops 1-4, tray 40% and clock as expected. Icon label My Documents touches the left edge (x=2).
01-02-start-menu: Menu opened with User header, Terminal, Notes, wobbly.rs, Chart, Page, right column, All Programs, Log Off/Turn Off. Each program row shows its command (chora-notes) as the grey subtitle, which reads like a file name, not a description.
01-03-hover-notes: Notes row highlighted blue; pointer arrow over the row.
01-04-notes-open: Menu closed, Notes window open at the top left (about 25,25), covering the My Documents and My Computer icons; task button Notes appears.
01-05-menu-again: Menu open again with the pointer on wobbly.rs highlighted.
01-06-two-windows: wobbly.rs opened over Notes, two task buttons; the window sits at an offset cascade.
01-07-taskbar-notes: Notes raised and its title bar blue; the wobbly.rs window behind is almost hidden: only its red close button shows at the right of Notes (surprising: the back window is larger than it looks, its frame is clipped).
01-10-paperclip-balloon: Paperclip appears at the bottom right with a balloon: Good morning! Your notes for Friday are ready. The word ready. wraps alone on the second line.
01-11-chat-open: Click on the paperclip opens the chat as a balloon: Chat with a helper, Close, 1 Atlas working, the sentence in bold, an input field with caret.
01-12-chat-collapsed: Chat closed with Close; only the paperclip stays; the balloon is gone.
01-14-helper-picked: Atlas picked by a click on its row: header Atlas working Tidy notes (1/2), Stop and Close, transcript You/Atlas lines; long lines are cut with an ellipsis (group them by day... , I would like to write...).
01-15-field-click: Click into the field: caret shows; the field has the keyboard.
01-16-typed: Typed text shows in the field at 6 characters a second.
01-17-sent: After Return the field is empty again but the transcript does not show the sent line (the fake agent does not echo it); no feedback that it was sent.
01-18-question: Question card: Atlas wants to write the file notes.txt, detail line, Alt+Y/Alt+N hint, Yes and No buttons; below it Typing does not answer. and A question is waiting. in the field.
01-19-answered: After the click on Yes the card stays unchanged until the agent closes the question (no feedback from the click itself).
01-19b-card-closed: After the fake agent sent done the card is gone and the helper works on (2/2).
01-20-f1: F1 does not open a key overlay in xp. The key goes to the focused Notes terminal, which prints the sequence ^[OP after 'effects' (visible in the window). Surprising: the brief expects a key overlay; xp has no F1 binding (F1 help exists only in the construct).
01-21-f1-again: F1 again: a second ^[OP is printed into the Notes terminal; no overlay.
